description: The bar chart, titled “QA-1,” visually compares the performance of three models — Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and an unlabeled model represented by a gray bar — across three response categories: Correct (dark purple), Partially Correct (medium blue), and Incorrect (light blue), as indicated by the legend below. The horizontal axis represents the proportion of responses falling into each category, ranging from 0 to 1, while the vertical axis lists the model names. For Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, the bar is segmented into 0.88 (Correct), 0.08 (Partially Correct), and 0.04 (Incorrect). EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and the unlabeled model both show identical performance: 0.96 (Correct), 0 (Partially Correct), and 0.04 (Incorrect), indicating no partially correct responses and identical accuracy and error rates. The chart highlights that both EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and the unlabeled model outperform Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B in terms of fully correct responses while maintaining the same low error rate, with the former achieving perfect scores in the partially correct category.
